Factor recovery is unconditional (no non-crossing hypothesis needed) — restriction of a glue is a pure label computation via glueLabel_offsetEmb_left/right, since each window carries the shifted Pi labels verbatim.
mathlibGaps: No NonCrossing/noncrossing partition API in Mathlib at all.
No operation restricting a Finpartition (Fin (n+1)) to a Finset/interval and re-indexing it as a Finpartition (Fin i).
Mathlib DyckWord has no Catalan-cardinality theorem and no Fintype instance; cannot be used as a counted Catalan family off the shelf.
